reviews.title: Customer reviews
reviews.emptyTitle: There are no customer reviews for this product yet.
reviews.emptyHint: Share your experience and write the first review — it helps others decide.

sandra.author: Sandra M.
sandra.text: Ordered on Tuesday, and by Thursday the machine was installed and running in the laundry room. The old appliance was taken away straight away — exactly as promised.

tobias.author: Tobias R.
tobias.purchase: Siemens EQ.6 plus s700 bean-to-cup coffee machine
tobias.text: I was torn between two bean-to-cup machines. The phone consultation took ten minutes and was refreshingly honest: the more expensive model would not have given me any real benefit.

kerstin.author: Kerstin B.
kerstin.text: The TV arrived with a scratch on the frame. The replacement was here two days later and the return was free of charge. One star off for the first attempt.

data.exportLegal: Right of access under Art. 15 GDPR and data portability under Art. 20 GDPR.

data.deleteRetention: Completed orders are kept: invoices and accounting records are subject to German commercial and tax retention periods (§ 147 AO, § 257 HGB). Art. 17(3)(b) GDPR expressly covers this case. Your orders are detached from your account and your contact details are removed from them.
